{{Quote|Ood&hellip;''gone''!''"<br />"''Disintegrated&hellip;and Sedriss with him! He did it to ''save'' us, Luke.|Luke Skywalker and Kam Solusar, witnessing the exertion of Jedi Master Ood Bnar|<ref name="de2 3" />}}
Some Jedi, commonly members of the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Species/Legends|species]], were capable of releasing an incredible '''beam of light''' as they channeled the sum of the [[The Force/Legends|Force energy]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on which they were rooted or other large energy source at their moment of [[Death/Legends|death]]. Such power was capable of catastrophic [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] surface destruction, as well as the obliteration of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and other vessels. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], to save [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Kam Solusar]], the ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ood Bnar]] released a devastating beam of light to annihilate [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Sedriss QL|Sedriss]].<ref name="de2 3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref>

More than [[138 ABY|one hundred]] years later, when Emperor Krayt's forces were triumphant in their assault, a female Neti Master named [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] was joined by fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Rawk|Nat Skywalker]], and together unleashed a beam of light to clear an escape route for their allies using the direct energy of the Temple's detonating reactor.<ref name="War4" />

Following the deaths of both Bnar and Saa, [[Ood Bnar's descendant|tiny]] [[T'ra Saa's descendants|saplings]] burst from the ground where the original Neti died, seemingly imbued with the planet's Force energy, still traveling through the engrained roots.<ref name="War4" />
